newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan buys 68,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat at tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys 68,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat at tender.

text.p: TAIPEI, April 23 Reuter) - The Taiwan Flour Mills Association bought 68,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat from Columbia Grain International in two shipments at a tender on Wednesday, traders said.
Each shipment contains Dark Northern Spring (DNS), Hard Red Winter (HRW) and White Wheat (WW), and all are slated for delivery from the Pacific Northwest, traders said.

The milling association placed the tender on behalf of several major Taiwan wheat buying companies -- including President Enterprise, Tai Yu Products, Chia Hsin, Formosa Oilseed and Lien Hwa Industry as well as other wheat millers.
Freight for the first shipment was fixed at US$20.50 per tonne from MIT and the second was at US$20.50 per tonne from TNC, traders said.
